sync.title: config-Sync
sync.hint1: Choose a folder inside your sync directory. Luxbox stores one file per device there and reconciles it with the other devices. The sync client itself transfers the file, Luxbox needs no credentials.
sync.hint2:
Synced: apps (name, address, options, order), settings and the list of store extensions.
Never synced: passwords, logins and cookies, extension data, favicons. You sign in yourself once on each device.

tour.d1: All your messengers and web apps in one window – with separate sessions, notifications and hibernation.
tour.d2: Use “+” to add apps. The “Group” field puts them into folders. Right-click an icon for settings, split view and a custom icon.
tour.d3: Right-click → “Show next to active app” puts two apps side by side. Drop files onto an app icon to send them.
tour.d4: Ctrl+Alt+L shows and hides the window, the X only minimizes it to the taskbar. Quit only via Settings → Quit.
tour.d5: Unread counts on the taskbar icon, notification clicks jump to the app. Keyboard shortcuts live in Settings → Keyboard shortcuts.
